breakdown.description: The task is a variable-cell relaxation, but the later instruction freezes the lattice vectors and allows only internal-coordinate relaxation.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core contradiction. The original prompt requested a `vc-relax` (variable-cell relaxation) but then incorrectly instructed to keep the lattice vectors fixed. The agent repeated both of these contradictory instructions by stating to `Perform a variable-cell relaxation (vc-relax) calculation` and also to `Keep the lattice vectors fixed during the ionic relaxation`. The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect instruction to keep the lattice fixed, which the agent failed to do.
